# Ezra Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 468r–469r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/EZR_002_page_001.jpg

---

**2:1** And-these [are] the-sons of-the-province [ha-medinah] the-ones-going-up from-the-captivity [shevi] of-the-exile [ha-golah] which Nevukhadnetsar king of-Bavel had-exiled [heglah] to-Bavel, and-they-returned to-Yerushalayim and-Yehudah, each-man to-his-city [iro],

**2:2** who-came with-Zerubbavel [Zerubbavel], Yeshua, Nechemyah, Serayah, Re'elayah, Mordekhai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rechum, Ba'anah. The-number [mispar] of-the-men of-the-people [am] of-Yisra'el:

**2:3** The-sons of-Par'osh — two-thousand one-hundred seventy-two.

**2:4** The-sons of-Shephatyah — three-hundred seventy-two.

**2:5** The-sons of-Arach — seven-hundred seventy-five.

**2:6** The-sons of-Pachat-Mo'av, of-the-sons of-Yeshua-Yo'av — two-thousand eight-hundred twelve.

**2:7** The-sons of-Elam — a-thousand two-hundred fifty-four.

**2:8** The-sons of-Zattu — nine-hundred forty-five.

**2:9** The-sons of-Zakkai — seven-hundred sixty.

**2:10** The-sons of-Bani — six-hundred forty-two.

**2:11** The-sons of-Bevai — six-hundred twenty-three.

**2:12** The-sons of-Azgad — a-thousand two-hundred twenty-two.

**2:13** The-sons of-Adoniqam — six-hundred sixty-six.

**2:14** The-sons of-Bigvai — two-thousand fifty-six.

**2:15** The-sons of-Adin — four-hundred fifty-four.

**2:16** The-sons of-Ater, of-Yechizkiyah — ninety-eight.

**2:17** The-sons of-Betsai — three-hundred twenty-three.

**2:18** The-sons of-Yorah — one-hundred twelve.

**2:19** The-sons of-Chashum — two-hundred twenty-three.

**2:20** The-sons of-Gibbar — ninety-five.

**2:21** The-sons of-Beit-Lechem [Bethlehem] — one-hundred twenty-three.

**2:22** The-men of-Netophah — fifty-six.

**2:23** The-men of-Anatot — one-hundred twenty-eight.

**2:24** The-sons of-Azmavet — forty-two.

**2:25** The-sons of-Qiryat-Arim, Kephirah, and-Be'erot — seven-hundred forty-three.

**2:26** The-sons of-ha-Ramah and-Geva — six-hundred twenty-one.

**2:27** The-men of-Mikhmas — one-hundred twenty-two.

**2:28** The-men of-Beit-El and-ha-Ai — two-hundred twenty-three.

**2:29** The-sons of-Nevo — fifty-two.

**2:30** The-sons of-Magbish — one-hundred fifty-six.

**2:31** The-sons of-the-other Elam — a-thousand two-hundred fifty-four.

**2:32** The-sons of-Charim — three-hundred twenty.

**2:33** The-sons of-Lod, Chadid, and-Ono — seven-hundred twenty-five.

**2:34** The-sons of-Yericho [Jericho] — three-hundred forty-five.

**2:35** The-sons of-Sena'ah — three-thousand six-hundred thirty.

**2:36** The-priests [ha-kohanim]: the-sons of-Yedayah, of-the-house of-Yeshua — nine-hundred seventy-three.

**2:37** The-sons of-Immer — a-thousand fifty-two.

**2:38** The-sons of-Pashchur — a-thousand two-hundred forty-seven.

**2:39** The-sons of-Charim — a-thousand seventeen.

**2:40** The-Levites [ha-leviyyim]: the-sons of-Yeshua and-Qadmi'el, of-the-sons of-Hodavyah — seventy-four.

**2:41** The-singers [ha-meshorerim]: the-sons of-Asaph — one-hundred twenty-eight.

**2:42** The-sons of-the-gatekeepers [ha-sho'arim]: the-sons of-Shallum, the-sons of-Ater, the-sons of-Talmon, the-sons of-Aqquv, the-sons of-Chatita, the-sons of-Shovai — in-all one-hundred thirty-nine.

**2:43** The-temple-servants [ha-netinim]: the-sons of-Tsicha, the-sons of-Chasupha, the-sons of-Tabba'ot,

**2:44** the-sons of-Qeros, the-sons of-Si'aha, the-sons of-Padon,

**2:45** the-sons of-Levanah, the-sons of-Chagavah, the-sons of-Aqquv,

**2:46** the-sons of-Chagav, the-sons of-Shamlai, the-sons of-Chanan,

**2:47** the-sons of-Giddel, the-sons of-Gachar, the-sons of-Re'ayah,

**2:48** the-sons of-Retsin, the-sons of-Neqoda, the-sons of-Gazzam,

**2:49** the-sons of-Uzza, the-sons of-Paseach, the-sons of-Besai,

**2:50** the-sons of-Asnah, the-sons of-Me'unim, the-sons of-Nephisim,

**2:51** the-sons of-Baqbuq, the-sons of-Chaqupha, the-sons of-Charchur,

**2:52** the-sons of-Batslut, the-sons of-Mechida, the-sons of-Charsha,

**2:53** the-sons of-Barqos, the-sons of-Sisera, the-sons of-Temach,

**2:54** the-sons of-Netsiach, the-sons of-Chatipha.

**2:55** The-sons of-the-servants of-Shelomoh [Solomon]: the-sons of-Sotai, the-sons of-ha-Sopheret, the-sons of-Peruda,

**2:56** the-sons of-Ya'alah, the-sons of-Darqon, the-sons of-Giddel,

**2:57** the-sons of-Shephatyah, the-sons of-Chattil, the-sons of-Pokheret ha-Tsevayim, the-sons of-Ami.

**2:58** All the-temple-servants [ha-netinim] and-the-sons of-the-servants of-Shelomoh — three-hundred ninety-two.

**2:59** And-these [are] the-ones-going-up from-Tel-Melach, Tel-Charsha, Keruv, Addan, Immer, and-not they-were-able [lo yakhlu] to-declare the-house of-their-fathers [beit avotam] and-their-seed [zar'am], whether from-Yisra'el they [were]:

**2:60** the-sons of-Delayah, the-sons of-Toviyah, the-sons of-Neqoda — six-hundred fifty-two.

**2:61** And-from-the-sons of-the-priests: the-sons of-Chavayah, the-sons of-ha-Qots, the-sons of-Barzillai — who took from-the-daughters of-Barzillai the-Gil'adite a-wife and-was-called by-their-name.

**2:62** These sought their-register [ketavam] among-those-enrolled-by-genealogy [ha-mityachasim] and-they-were-not-found [lo nimtse'u], and-they-were-excluded-as-defiled [vayego'alu] from-the-priesthood [min-ha-kehunnah].

**2:63** And-the-Tirshata [the-governor] said to-them that they-should-not eat from-the-most-holy-things [qodesh ha-qodashim] until a-priest stood-up [ya'amod] with-Urim and-Thummim.

**2:64** All the-assembly [ha-qahal] as-one [ke-echad] — forty-two thousand three-hundred sixty,

**2:65** apart-from their-male-servants [avdeihem] and-their-female-servants [amhoteihem] — these [were] seven-thousand three-hundred thirty-seven; and-to-them singers [meshorerim] and-female-singers [meshorarot] — two-hundred.

**2:66** Their-horses [suseihem] — seven-hundred thirty-six; their-mules [pirdeihem] — two-hundred forty-five;

**2:67** their-camels [gemaleihem] — four-hundred thirty-five; donkeys [chamorim] — six-thousand seven-hundred twenty.

**2:68** And-some of-the-heads of-the-fathers [rashei ha-avot], when-they-came to-the-house of-YHWH which [is] in-Yerushalayim, freely-offered [hitnadvu] for-the-house of-the-God to-set-it-up [leha'amido] upon its-foundation [mekhono].

**2:69** According-to-their-ability [kekhocham] they-gave to-the-treasury [la-otsar] of-the-work: gold — sixty-one thousand darics [darkemonim], and-silver — five-thousand minas [maneh], and-tunics of-priests [kotnot kohanim] — one-hundred.

**2:70** And-the-priests [ha-kohanim] and-the-Levites and-[some] from-the-people and-the-singers and-the-gatekeepers and-the-temple-servants [ha-netinim] settled [yashvu] in-their-cities, and-all Yisra'el in-their-cities.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — "Zerubbabel, Yeshua":** The list of twelve leaders may correspond symbolically to the twelve tribes. Zerubbabel (*zeru-Babel*, "seed of Babylon") is of Davidic lineage; Yeshua (Joshua) is the high priest. This dual leadership — civil and sacral — is a key structural feature of the restoration community.

**v.59-63 — Genealogical crisis:** The phrase *lo yakhlu lehagid beit avotam* ("they could not declare their fathers' house") reveals that identity depended on documented patrilineal descent. Those who could not prove priestly lineage were "excluded as defiled" (*vayego'alu*) — the root *ga'al* here means "polluted/disqualified," not the homonym meaning "redeemed."

**v.63 — "Urim and Thummim":** The reference to these oracular devices is remarkable in a post-exilic text. No priest with Urim and Thummim ever appears; the priestly families in question seem to remain permanently excluded.

*— EMET*
